_about: Defaults for textures you don't supply. Values come from analysing Liu Kang's LIU_SKIN_A material. The colour result in-game is NOT yet confirmed; edit these values and re-convert if colours look tinted.

ColorOverride._why: alpha 1 = Liu's special 'override' regions (palette element 0); 0 = normal palette path

Normal._why: Blender bakes OpenGL normal maps; MK11 expects DirectX (green flipped). Alpha matches Liu's typical value.

Id._why: red = palette element x 16 + 8; element 15 (248) is neutral grey 0.498 in both colourway rows
